newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Scitex meets on reorganisation plan.
newsitem.headline: Scitex meets on reorganisation plan.

text.p: Israel's Scitex Corp Ltd board of directors is due to meet on Thursday to approve the company's reorganisation plan, a spokesman said on Wednesday.
The meeting comes amid reports in the Israeli press that Scitex plans to lay off hundreds of workers beginning next week.

A report in the mass circulation daily Yedioth Ahronoth quoted an unnamed Scitex official as saying that the layoffs were part of a reorganisation plan involving the company's operations in Israel and abroad.
Scitex would not comment on the report, but the spokesman said the company was likely to make an announcement on Monday following the board meeting.
The Herzliya-based company is a world leader in the field of of digital and pre-press printing and has entered the digital video and other related fields in recent years.

Scitex reported a net loss of $6.0 million for the second quarter of 1996. When the results were published the company said a reorganisation plan was needed to reduce losses and return to profitability.
Several senior company officials have resigned in recent weeks.
Scitex shares on Nasdaq rose on Tuesday by 4.6 percent but are still trading close to their low for the year.
